description: Copy a timeline under a new name — a backup of the cut before a review round changes it, or a variant to try something on. A DEEP copy: new ids for the timeline, its tracks, clips and transitions; links between clips (A/V pairs, caption groups) are kept, inside the copy. Nested timelines are copied too by default (includeNested), so editing a nest in the original does not change the backup; motion compositions and media are referenced, not copied. The original is not touched and stays the active timeline; one undo removes the copy. Returns {timelineId, name, clips, nestedCopies?}.

includeNested.description: Copy nested timelines too (default true). false = the copy shares them with the original.

name.description: Name of the copy. Default '<name> copy'.

token.description: The session token `connect` returned. Pass it on every call — it says which browser to drive.

name: duplicate_timeline
